title: clinopodium vulgare var. neogaeum
intro: Clinopodium vulgare var. neogaeum, commonly known as a variety of wild basil, is a plant species in the mint family (Lamiaceae). This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to aid in digestion, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Clinopodium vulgare var. neogaeum include its analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, which may help to soothe digestive issues and promote wound healing. Bioactive constituents present in the plant include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
